opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed the growing chemistry between the leads and found their relationship unusually natural and believable.
Rose’s flustered reactions and romantic awkwardness were repeatedly described as funny, charming, and highly entertaining.
Commenters appreciated the low-key atmosphere and gradual romantic development.
Several people praised Harij as considerate and supportive, while also viewing Tien’s care for Rose favorably.
Some viewers liked the episode but remained uncertain about Harij’s hidden motives and whether the central request could create future trouble.
The darker emotional material prompted hopes that the series would become lighter and fluffier going forward.
